summary: Full backend + frontend review of Phase 1 Nutrition ERP. 24/24 backend tests pass covering Auth, RBAC, Products, Suppliers, Customers, Warehouses, Inventory (filters/adjust/negative-guard), full PO->GRN lifecycle, SO FEFO allocate+dispatch, Dashboard shape, Advertising, Audit logs. Frontend login reaches dashboard, 8 KPI tiles render, 14-day revenue + campaign charts render, Products (14 seeded shown), PO-2026-00001 present, SOs listed, Advertising shows 5 connected platforms + 8 campaigns, Inventory Adjust modal opens.

critical.endpoint: PATCH /api/products/{id} (and any audited mutation containing Decimal fields)
critical.issue: AuditLog.details column (JSON) failed to serialize Decimal values -> 500 Internal Server Error. Root cause in /app/backend/helpers.py log_audit stored raw dicts containing Decimal from Pydantic payloads. FIXED by adding _jsonable converter.

minor.issue: SKU auto-generation uses count(*)+1 pattern => UniqueViolation when existing seeded SKUs collide with the auto-generated base pattern (eg two 'TEST_...' products both get 'TEST-00015'). Not race-safe and not collision-safe with pre-existing SKUs. Workaround: client supplies explicit sku.
Same count+1 numbering antipattern across PO/GRN/SO/Supplier/Customer code generators - works in dev but not concurrency safe.

issues: Recharts emits width(-1)/height(-1) console warnings on first paint before ResizeObserver settles. Cosmetic only; charts render correctly afterwards.

action_items: Audit log Decimal serialization fix already applied in /app/backend/helpers.py (added _jsonable). Please review and keep.
Replace count(*)+1 based auto numbering (SKU, PO#, GRN#, SO#, supplier code, customer code, warehouse code) with race-safe sequence (DB sequence, UUID suffix, or retry-on-conflict) before production.
Optionally set a min width on the dashboard chart container to suppress Recharts first-paint warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: helpers.log_audit stored Pydantic-derived dicts into JSON column without sanitising Decimal/date -> 500 on any UPDATE path with price/qty fields. Pattern-wide risk.
All *_number()/_gen_code() helpers use `count(*) + 1` -> not concurrency-safe and prone to UniqueViolation when SKUs/codes with that pattern already exist.
sales_router _so_out references a leftover `l.__dict__.get('_allocated_batch')` placeholder and always returns `allocated_batch_number=None` even after allocation - minor UX issue in SO detail view.
dashboard_router contains dead code block `) if False else []` (lines ~140) - harmless but should be removed.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup') (Pydantic v2 / FastAPI lifespan preferred).
Startup Base.metadata.create_all + seed_if_empty is OK for Phase 1 but Alembic migrations should be added before Phase 2.
updated_files: /app/backend/helpers.py (fixed JSON serialization for Decimal/date in audit log)
test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md - used admin/md/procurement/warehouse/sales/rep accounts, all authenticated successfully.
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_-prefixed Products/Suppliers/Customers/Warehouses, 2 POs (new flow + seed), 2 SOs (FEFO + insufficient-stock cases). All marked for cleanup via TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and run serial (-n 0) due to shared preview backend. Fixtures reuse session-scoped JWTs. One real backend bug fixed in helpers.py (Decimal in audit JSON). SKU/code auto-numbering uses count+1 which is not race safe - tests supply explicit sku to work around. FEFO test accepts tie-breaks when multiple batches share the earliest expiry.
rca of the issue: Audit UPDATE 500: helpers.log_audit persisted Pydantic payload dicts directly into AuditLog.details (JSON column). psycopg2 json_serializer uses stdlib json which raises TypeError on Decimal. Reproduced via PATCH /api/products/{id} with {'selling_price':399}. Fix: convert Decimal->str and date/datetime->isoformat recursively before persisting.
